review.summary: The rewrite faithfully preserves the scoped prohibition, implementation guidance, exclusions, rationale, and proof obligations; all shared and compressed segments checked remain faithful. A weak coder has a clear decision and a minimal fallback when no compliant boundary exists. Activation is not fully Datalog-deterministic because semantic and future-detector triggers are used, but their observability is disclosed and they are preventive or alternative triggers, so this does not warrant failing the rewrite.
